property_summary: After rely(user) is called by an authorized ward (wards[msg.sender]==1), the wards[user] must become 1; the bug inverts the auth check so no one can ever become authorized to call rely, leaving wards[user] unchanged.
change_summary: Change the require condition from wards[msg.sender] == 1 to wards[msg.sender] == 0, inverting the authorization logic.
